name: Sports
description: Possession sport: win the ball, advance it against a defensive shape, score across a line, and reset — against a clock with periods, stoppages, and a referee. movement.ball_carrier makes possession a physical state with a cost, world.goal_zone turns the line into a rules-driven scoring fact, and social.team_roster, utility.match_clock, and utility.referee_rules supply the structure that makes two mobs chasing a ball into a match.

signatureCompound.name: Possession to Goal
signatureCompound.description: Two rosters, one ball, one clock: carry, pass, and skill-move through a defensive line, score across the goal zone's decision plane, and reset to kickoff as the match clock banks the stoppage. Proves the loop's causal chain: possession costs speed, advancement risks the ball, and scoring is a rules event, not a collision.
